messages:
rachel: heads-up: deploybot detected a compatibility skew for quant-v5b when served on runtime 2.20 in ap-southeast-1. error spikes on sessions >4k tokens. recommend a regional escape-hatch (soft-pin) while we triage. :triage_table_tone:
deploybot: NOTICE: compatibility-check failed -> model=quant-v5b, runtime=2.20, region=ap-southeast-1. Observed: 3.9% checksum mismatches on longseq tests. Suggested action: regional soft-pin to runtime:2.19 and route new sessions to f32-fallback.
omar: can we get a minimal log snippet? need to know if it's kvcache index drift or something else.
rachel: logs attached. snippet:
```
[2026-05-11T09:14:02Z] runtime-2.20 kernelZ: kvcache window_mismatch shard=6 expected_seq=20481 got=20463
[2026-05-11T09:14:02Z] model quant-v5b: attention_state checksum != stored_checksum
```
jyoti: note: SDK 3.3 client added an async prefetch for KV pages. double-checking whether client-side ordering could surface on newer runtimes. SDK sigs look unchanged but behavior may be timing-sensitive.
marco: if it's region-only, let's avoid global rollback. i'm in favor of soft-pin + fallback routing. cost impact: f32-fallback will ~2.1x token-cost for v5b sessions. ops-sre: we need autoscale headroom before switching.
ops-sre: will pre-warm a small f32 pool and add alerts: ap-southeast-1 quant-v5b errors >1% for 5m -> pager; 95p latency >200ms -> pager. also set a cost spike alert.
kate: product note: if TTL >24h, we must publish a short customer FYI and add a changelog bullet under "regional fallbacks." I'll draft if we extend.
rachel: proposed plan: 1) apply region soft-pin (12h) 2) route new sessions to f32-fallback only 3) eng-runtime + eng-sdk reproduce and iterate on patch 4) test kernel fix in eu-canary, lift pin when green. agree?
omar: +1 regional only. triage owner: omar + jyoti pairing on reproducer.
deploybot: EXECUTE: pin add --scope region --region ap-southeast-1 --target runtime:2.19 --model quant-v5b --reason "kvcache window mismatch on longseq" --mode soft --ttl 12h
deploybot: Pin applied (soft). pin_id=pin_4961122334. New sessions in ap-southeast-1 will prefer runtime:2.19 for quant-v5b. Auto-unpin TTL=12h unless extended by owner. Audit: user=rachel.
marco: prepping fallback scaling rules and a 10% pre-warm. ETA ~18m.
jyoti: i'll instrument the SDK prefetch ordering and run longseq harness with interleaved client timing. will open PR if deterministic. ETA ~3h.
ops-sre: added a temporary routing rule and the alerts. will monitor cost & latency dashboards.
product: draft for changelog: "APAC users: temporary routing to float fallback for quant-v5b due to long-sequence KV alignment issue; regional soft-pin applied." will circulate.
rachel: set pin TTL extension to 24h if we don't have a deterministic fix by +6h. otherwise we'll lift after eu-canary green. keeping this thread as SOT; ping here for any urgent changes. :white_check_mark:
